verdicts.reason: A reads left to right: logo, can, SUNSET SALE badge, headline, body and CTA, which is roughly the right order for a banner. But the SOLSTICE wordmark is shrunk until you can barely see it, and the body copy on the right is crammed with very little space around it. The legal line is tiny and collides with the grey missing-asset placeholder, and the SUNSET SALE badge is jammed against the can. B is worse. The oversized headline fills the full height, pressed against the top and bottom edges, and the CTA comes before the product. Logo, can, badges, SUNSET SALE badge, body copy and legal text are all squeezed into tiny, overlapping, unreadable pieces, and the body copy is one unreadable line of micro text, so the right half is a jumbled mess.
